messages:
laura_mkt: Heads-up: Cascade Electrics interview landed for Thurs 11am PT with their CTO. Goal: 500–700 word customer spotlight + short clip. Need quote approvals + legal release. Who's owning what? :tada:

sam_se: I can run the interview. Will ask about throughput gains and deployment model. Do we want to surface Dedicated vs Hosted usage?

laura_mkt: Yes — highlight Dedicated use and cost savings. Sam, can you pull the numbers (p95 latency, cost/run) so we can quote them?

jess_content: I'll draft Qs and a short narrative arc. Can I get the transcript and a quick quote by EOD Friday?

nikhil_design: Need Cascade logo (vector) + screenshot of Console showing dashboards. Anyone have assets? Also prefer a 16:9 clip for the webinar highlight.

rachel_legal: I'll review the draft + release form. Standard turnaround is 48 business hours after we have the signed release and the verbatim quote text. Please add their legal contact in the doc.

laura_mkt: Adding release form to the shared doc: https://redwood.app/docs/shared/cascade-release. @marta — can you review & sign? Also flagging the exact quote we plan to publish under 'Proposed Quotes'.

sam_se: Routing webinar leads: after publish, we'll route inbound demo requests to AE queue 'ae-north-america' and tag them cascade-electrics. Noting for ops.

ops_bot: Reminder set: Interview on Thu 11:00 PT — calendar invite sent to participants.

jess_content: Draft Qs here (short list): 1) Why Redwood? 2) What changed in infra? 3) Measured impact? Also included suggested pull-quote: 'Redwood cut our inference cost by ~40% and halved tail latency.' pls confirm accuracy.

laura_mkt: Marta verbally approved that wording, but Rachel needs the exact metric source. Sam, attach the runbook / metric export.

sam_se: Attached metric export link: https://redwood.app/exports/cascade/metrics.csv and a snippet: p95 latency from 210ms -> 120ms after Dedicated rollout; token cost dropped ~39% on our benchmarks. Happy to put into the doc.

rachel_legal: Okay with that as long as we attribute to 'internal production benchmark' and add the release signature. Once signed, I'll clear the quote.

laura_mkt: Perfect. I'll chase Marta for signature now. Thanks all — will update thread when signed. :slightly_smiling_face:
